about: A comment on its own line under 2026-09-20 scopes the two untagged bullets below it. The piece's only trigger line is the comment. u1 (the Mara line to idea-mara) is approved on round 0; u2 (the Tobias line to idea-tobias) gets a fix on rounds 0, 1 and 2 and is undone after round 2, its copy leaving idea-tobias. `pointers` writes u1's pointer on the untagged Mara line. The Edit guard gives [] and the run closes with no second check. The handled list: u1's source line as `migrated`, with its pointer, and u1's copy as `written`. The comment stays off, because its piece holds the source line of an undone unit, so the next run hands the piece to the migrator again; the Tobias line stays off. The log opens with 'Nothing needs you.' and holds Migrated, then Units undone, ending 'The next migration run tries this again.'

readings: New handled entries follow the ones already there, sorted by note path (as Python sorts strings, so 'Ideas/…' comes before 'brain-dump.md'), then by their place in the note at close.

An untagged source line of a counted migrate unit goes on as `migrated` (CONTRACT.md 5.6 item 3, first bullet names every source line; item 3's last bullet says a line that isn't a trigger line still goes on).
u1's copy carries #status/tentative, from status_from 'default', since neither the comment nor the line names a status.
Units undone quotes only the last round's problems, as '{check}: {what}', as in case 141.
